# Navigator

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-13e3572683cf7ebf"></a>

## Become a Navigator

Nami wants to draw a map of the whole world. Nobody has ever finished one.

Choose Navigator as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Navigator

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Navigator XP +300

<a id="q-7c951dd26e98f9ee"></a>

## Apprentice Navigator

A Log Pose, a barometer and good instincts.

Reach Navigator level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Navigator](navigator.md#q-13e3572683cf7ebf)

**Tasks**

- Reach Navigator level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Navigator XP +800

<a id="q-523cffb5895a9153"></a>

## Journeyman Navigator

Chart the seas, build a barometer and let the Log Pose recognise twenty-five islands.

Reach Navigator level 25 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Navigator](navigator.md#q-7c951dd26e98f9ee)

**Tasks**

- Reach Navigator level 25
- Make a Barometer
- Make a Sea Chart
- Have your Log Pose recognise 25 islands

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Navigator XP +3,000

<a id="q-17028e1d557f850e"></a>

## Expert Navigator

Make an Eternal Pose, see every land in your log book and visit Weatheria, where the sky itself is studied.

Reach Navigator level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Navigator](navigator.md#q-523cffb5895a9153)

**Tasks**

- Reach Navigator level 50
- Make an Eternal Pose
- See every land of the world
- Land on Weatheria

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Navigator XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-1536fd1a9a24e928"></a>

## Master Navigator

The mapmaker of the world draws what everyone else sails.

Reach Navigator level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Navigator](navigator.md#q-17028e1d557f850e)

**Tasks**

- Reach Navigator level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
